narratives.device_down_explanation: The device stopped responding to health checks and was marked unreachable. Any dependent downstream devices will be isolated.
narratives.device_down_actionable: Check power supply, Ethernet cable, or switch port connection.
narratives.device_degraded_explanation: One or more health checks failed or show anomalies (e.g. high latency, DNS timeout or packet loss), while base ping is responding.
narratives.device_degraded_actionable: Inspect logs of the specific service (e.g. DNS server, AdGuard container, or HTTP port).
narratives.device_flapping_explanation: The device repeatedly alternates between up and down states within a short time window.
narratives.device_flapping_actionable: Possible faulty cable, Wi-Fi radio interference, network loop, or failing power supply.
narratives.device_ok_explanation: All configured health checks have passed. Service continuity has been restored.
narratives.check_actionable: Inspect threshold parameters or target service configuration.
narratives.incident_opened_explanation: {{msg}} Topological correlation algorithm estimated confidence at {{conf}}. {{impacted}}
narratives.incident_opened_actionable: Prioritize troubleshooting on '{{name}}' to cascade-restore all connected devices.
narratives.root_cause_shift_headline: Incident Update: New root cause on {{name}}
narratives.root_cause_shift_explanation: {{msg}} Failure origin relocated to an upstream structural node.
narratives.root_cause_shift_actionable: Incident root cause has shifted to '{{name}}'.
narratives.incident_resolved_explanation: All nodes and services have returned to optimal parameters. No action required.
narratives.reboot_explanation: {{msg}} Uptime counter or device boot ID was reset.
narratives.reboot_actionable: If this reboot was unplanned, inspect power stability or device system logs.
narratives.link_flap_explanation: {{msg}} Frequent state changes detected within time window.
narratives.link_flap_actionable: Check switch port auto-negotiation and physical cable integrity.
narratives.monitor_restart_explanation: Monitoring and telemetry engine initialized successfully.
narratives.ups_on_battery_explanation: Mains utility power loss detected by UPS.
narratives.ups_on_battery_actionable: Check main electrical breaker or prepare graceful shutdown of critical servers.
narratives.storage_degraded_explanation: A storage pool or drive reported error or degraded status.
narratives.storage_degraded_actionable: Replace the faulty drive promptly to prevent data loss.
narratives.firmware_update_explanation: The firmware version of the device has changed.
narratives.device_offline_explanation: Device {{name}}{{ip}} stopped responding (previous status: {{from}}){{reason}} and has been marked as unreachable.
narratives.device_offline_actionable: Check power supply, network cabling, or upstream switch status for {{name}}.
narratives.device_managed_explanation: Device {{name}}{{ip}} is currently within a scheduled maintenance window{{reason}}. Alerts are muted.
narratives.device_managed_actionable: No action required: notifications remain muted until the maintenance window ends.
narratives.device_restored_explanation: Device {{name}}{{ip}} has resumed responding normally to health checks (new status: {{to}}).

rule_01_wan_loss.title: Internet Connection Unavailable (ISP or Line Failure)
rule_01_wan_loss.summary: Local gateway is fully operational and reachable, but outbound connectivity (public DNS or WAN ping) is broken. The internal LAN is healthy.

rule_02_gateway_down.title: Network Gateway Offline (Powered off or Frozen)
rule_02_gateway_down.summary: The main router/gateway is not responding to checks. All external destinations and inter-VLAN routes are isolated.

rule_03_ap_reboot.title: Access Point Recently Rebooted
rule_03_ap_reboot.summary: The access point uptime reset while the physical switch link remained constantly active. Indicates a reboot due to crash, watchdog, or firmware update.

rule_04_ap_poe_loss.title: Access Point Offline due to Power Loss or Disconnected Cable
rule_04_ap_poe_loss.summary: The access point does not respond and physical link is absent. The PoE injector or switch port is not delivering power or the cable is disconnected.

rule_05_cable_flapping.title: Unstable Network Cabling or Degraded Negotiated Speed
rule_05_cable_flapping.summary: Frequent link up/down state changes (link flapping) or transmission errors detected. Typical symptom of faulty crimping or electromagnetic interference.

rule_06_switch_down.title: Core Network Switch Unreachable (Downstream Nodes Isolated)
rule_06_switch_down.summary: The switch is not responding to checks and all downstream devices are simultaneously unreachable from the monitor. The switch is the root cause.

rule_07_nas_dhcp_dns_down.title: NAS Offline: DNS, DHCP, and Storage Services Interrupted
rule_07_nas_dhcp_dns_down.summary: The NAS is completely offline. Consequently, clients lose name resolution and DHCP lease renewals, but the switching infrastructure is healthy.

rule_08_dns_degraded.title: DNS Service Unresponsive or Upstream SERVFAIL
rule_08_dns_degraded.summary: IP-level network functions normally, but DNS queries to the local resolver fail or return forwarding errors to upstream servers.

rule_09_dhcp_failure.title: DHCP Service Stopped or Address Pool Exhausted
rule_09_dhcp_failure.summary: New clients cannot acquire an IP address, although the host server is reachable on the network.

rule_10_ups_on_battery.title: Power Outage: UPS Operating on Battery
rule_10_ups_on_battery.summary: The UPS has switched to On Battery (OB) state. Devices without battery backup protection are powered off.

rule_11_vantage_point_isolated.title: Monitor (Vantage Point) is Isolated from the Network
rule_11_vantage_point_isolated.summary: NetSentinel cannot communicate with any device, not even its immediate switch or gateway. The issue is local to the monitoring host.

rule_12_storage_degraded.title: Early Warning: Storage Disk Failure Risk or Degraded Volume
rule_12_storage_degraded.summary: S.M.A.R.T. parameters worsened (reallocated sectors) or RAID volume is in degraded state. Immediate risk of data loss.

rule_13_service_hang.title: Host Operational but Application Service (e.g. Home Assistant) Unresponsive
rule_13_service_hang.summary: Host responds to ICMP ping, but the service API or web UI is frozen or timing out.

rule_14_firmware_upgrade.title: Firmware Upgrade or Scheduled Maintenance Reboot
rule_14_firmware_upgrade.summary: Temporary disconnection with recovery and incremented firmware version recorded.

rule_ap_controller_desync.title: Access Point Active on LAN but Disconnected from UniFi Controller
rule_ap_controller_desync.summary: The AP responds to direct ping and clients browse normally, but the UniFi Controller reports it as disconnected or isolated (inform port 8080/tcp issue).

rule_ap_ip_lease_loss.title: Access Point Powered (PoE Active) but Missing IP Address / Unreachable
rule_ap_ip_lease_loss.summary: The switch delivers PoE power and physical Ethernet link is active, but the AP does not respond at IP level. Likely DHCP lease renewal failure.

rule_generic_failure.title: Device failure: {{name}}
rule_generic_failure.summary: Device '{{name}}' is unreachable from the monitor. No upstream node is faulty.
